Serilog.// WriteTo: Config-file merging is by array index: index 0 ({}) is a deliberate no-op that leaves appsettings.json's WriteTo:0 (the Console sink) untouched; index 1 overrides only appsettings.json's WriteTo:1.Args.path, renaming the file sink's output from logs/newsroom-.log to logs/sandbox-.log without touching its other Args (rollingInterval, retainedFileCountLimit, outputTemplate).
